reports.notes: Handwritten on the printed v. 12.23 form. Boxes C and E carry '$ 10,391.30', the year-to-date carry-forward matching this filer's earlier amended report. The cover page's own 'Date of Report' box was left blank by the filer; report_date is taken from the cover signature Date ('Dec. 5 2024'), which is also what the filer wrote in the Date of Report box on pages 2 and 3. The summary page's Name of Candidate / Date of Report / Page boxes were also left blank. Clerk RECEIVED stamp DEC 05 2024 on every page.
